witness_description: No concrete witness: the supplied quote does not define the operators or specify which values of c and n are admissible.
search_space: All 153 ordered integer pairs (c, n) with -8 <= c <= 8 and 0 <= n <= 8, visited in increasing c and then increasing n. The sweep exhaustively checks whether both displayed right-hand sides are arithmetically defined; it cannot evaluate the undefined operators Delta and Sigma.
refutation_explanation: The quote only states the displayed equations; it does not define Delta or Sigma, quantify c and n, specify their domains, or address c = 1. Thus the left-hand sides cannot be evaluated from the supplied data. The quotient on the displayed right-hand side is undefined at c = 1, but that is not honestly a counterexample without knowing that c = 1 is admissible and what the claimed equality means there.
